bombas.identity.category.value: comfort focused sock and apparel brand
bombas.identity.category.text: Bombas describes itself as a comfort focused sock and apparel brand with a mission to help those in need.

bombas.identity.one_line_pitch.value: purpose built for athletic performance, engineered for extreme comfort
bombas.identity.one_line_pitch.text: Bombas describes its products as purpose built for athletic performance and engineered for extreme comfort.

bombas.identity.giving_model.value: one pair purchased equals one pair donated
bombas.identity.giving_model.text: Bombas runs a giving model where one pair purchased equals one pair donated.

bombas.identity.donation_milestone.value: passed 50 million items donated, milestone page published
bombas.identity.donation_milestone.text: Bombas has a page marking that it passed 50 million items donated, though the exact current running total is not shown on this page.

bombas.products.lines.text: Bombas' public product feed lists socks, underwear, t-shirts, slippers, compression sleeves, bralettes, clogs, moccasins, sandals, a digital gift card, and a small accessories and bags set as its product types.

bombas.products.price_ladder_socks.text: In a 250 product sample of the live catalog, sock listings priced from about 13 to 215 dollars, with the high end reflecting large multi packs.

bombas.products.price_ladder_underwear.text: In the same catalog sample, underwear listings priced from about 18 to 270 dollars across single items and large packs.

bombas.products.pack_sizes.text: Bombas sells socks and underwear as singles and in 3, 4, 6, 7, 8 and 12 packs, with pack ladder pricing built into the same listing.

bombas.products.materials.text: Bombas product tags name merino wool, cotton, performance athletic material and compression knit as its main sock materials.

bombas.products.hero_flag_selling_fast.text: At least one live product, the Women's Golf Ankle Sock 6-Pack, carries a selling fast badge tag in the product feed.

bombas.products.hero_flag_new.value: status:new tag used on some listings
bombas.products.hero_flag_new.text: Some live product listings carry a status new tag in the product feed, marking them as recently launched.

bombas.products.gift_card.text: Bombas sells a digital gift card in denominations from 25 to 300 dollars.

bombas.offers.free_shipping_threshold_us.text: Bombas offers free standard shipping on US orders of 75 dollars or more, after discount and before tax.

bombas.offers.standard_shipping_cost.text: Orders under 75 dollars pay a flat 7.95 dollar standard shipping rate.

bombas.offers.guarantee.value: Happiness Guarantee, 30 day standard return window (60 days for Nov-Dec purchases)
bombas.offers.guarantee.text: Bombas backs purchases with its Happiness Guarantee and a 30 day return window, extended to 60 days for holiday season purchases.

bombas.offers.bundles_pack_ladder.text: Bombas prices socks and underwear as singles or in 3, 4, 6, 7, 8 and 12 packs, with a per pack price that discounts against buying singles.

bombas.offers.gifting.value: digital gift cards from $25 to $300, plus a bulk and corporate gifting program
bombas.offers.gifting.text: Bombas sells digital gift cards from 25 to 300 dollars and runs a separate bulk gifting page aimed at families, offices and friends buying in volume.

bombas.policies.returns_window_days.text: Bombas accepts returns for a refund within 30 days of purchase, or 60 days for holiday season purchases.

bombas.policies.refund_method.text: Bombas refunds go back to the original method of payment only.

bombas.policies.happiness_guarantee.value: promise to make it right if the customer is not happy, subject to stated exceptions
bombas.policies.happiness_guarantee.text: The Bombas Happiness Guarantee is Bombas own promise to make a purchase right if the customer is not happy with it.

bombas.policies.exchanges.value: replacement, exchange or code available after the initial refund window
bombas.policies.exchanges.text: After the initial refund window Bombas still offers a replacement or exchange code under the Happiness Guarantee.

bombas.policies.shipping_options.text: Bombas US shipping ranges from free standard shipping on orders of $75 or more to paid priority shipping in 1 to 3 business days.

bombas.policies.privacy_effective_date.text: The Bombas Privacy Policy and Cookie Policy currently posted is effective April 9, 2026.

value: pages visited and time on site
bombas.policies.privacy_data_collected.text: Bombas privacy policy states it collects contact details users submit plus passive usage data like IP address and browsing behavior.

bombas.policies.cookie_categories.text: Bombas groups its site cookies into strictly necessary, functional, advertising performance, targeting and two Global-e vendor categories.

bombas.policies.terms_effective_date.text: The Bombas Terms and Conditions of Use currently posted is effective November 17, 2025.

bombas.policies.terms_liability_cap.text: Bombas terms of service cap its liability for damages at 100 dollars except where a specific Bombas policy applies differently.

bombas.claims.donation_pledge.value: one purchased equals one donated, guarantee/mission claim
bombas.claims.donation_pledge.text: Bombas states that for every item purchased it donates one item, always and forever.

bombas.claims.donation_exclusion.value: replacement and exchange items do not trigger a new donation, guarantee claim detail
bombas.claims.donation_exclusion.text: Bombas states that a replacement or exchange item does not trigger an additional donation.

bombas.claims.guarantee_promise.value: guarantee claim: will do everything possible to make an unhappy purchase right
bombas.claims.guarantee_promise.text: Bombas Happiness Guarantee claims it will do everything it can to make a purchase right if the customer is not happy.

bombas.claims.ankle_socks_benefit.value: material and comfort claim: moisture-wicking cotton, blister tab, cushioned footbed, arch support
bombas.claims.ankle_socks_benefit.text: Bombas ankle socks are described as moisture-wicking with a blister tab, a cushioned footbed and its Honeycomb Arch Support System.

bombas.claims.calf_socks_benefit.value: material and comfort claim: extra-long staple cotton, stay-up technology, invisitoe, y-stitched heel, arch support
bombas.claims.calf_socks_benefit.text: Bombas calf socks are described with extra-long staple cotton, stay-up technology, an invisitoe, a y-stitched heel and the Honeycomb Arch Support System.

bombas.claims.brand_positioning.value: comparison/positioning claim: purpose built for athletic performance, engineered for extreme comfort
bombas.claims.brand_positioning.text: Bombas describes its products as purpose built for athletic performance and engineered for extreme comfort.

bombas.voice.donation_tagline.value: One purchased = one donated, always and forever.
bombas.voice.donation_tagline.text: Bombas repeats the same donation tagline word for word across its homepage and its Happiness Guarantee page.

bombas.voice.legal_tone_statement.value: self-described casual, friendly tone, stated even in its own legal terms
bombas.voice.legal_tone_statement.text: Bombas opens its terms of service by calling itself informal and saying it tried to make the legal document less dull to read.

bombas.voice.bee_origin_phrase.value: name origin story told with a short, plain, first-person aside
bombas.voice.bee_origin_phrase.text: Bombas explains its own name through the bumblebee origin story and adds the short aside We like that.

bombas.site_map.home.text: The live storefront's home page is at https://shop.bombas.com/, served on the Shopify platform.

bombas.site_map.sitemap_index.text: The sitemap index lists 5 sub sitemaps: an agentic discovery sitemap, 2 product sitemap shards, 1 pages sitemap and 1 collections sitemap.

bombas.site_map.pages_sitemap_count.text: The pages sitemap lists 117 URLs under /pages/, covering legal pages, brand fact pages, seasonal landers and old campaign pages.

bombas.site_map.legal_pages.text: The pages sitemap includes at least 5 legal pages: a privacy policy, terms and conditions, a Washington specific privacy policy, a do not sell webform and an accessibility page.

bombas.site_map.facts_pages.text: The pages sitemap includes brand fact pages: B Corp certification, a 50 million donated milestone, sock technology, giving back, size guide, sustainability and about us.

bombas.site_map.crawl_access.value: products, collections and pages crawlable; cart, checkout, account and admin disallowed
bombas.site_map.crawl_access.text: The storefront robots.txt allows crawling of product, collection and page URLs and disallows cart, checkout, account and admin paths, and it also names a separate agent facing UCP or MCP endpoint for commerce actions.

bombas.stack.platform.text: Bombas runs its storefront on Shopify, on the store handle bombas.myshopify.com.

bombas.stack.theme.value: custom React storefront theme, theme id 167322255714
bombas.stack.theme.text: The storefront uses a custom React based theme built on Shopify, loaded through a react-app.js bundle.

bombas.stack.reviews_app.text: Bombas uses Yotpo as its reviews platform, loaded as a web pixel on the storefront.

bombas.stack.upsell_app.text: Bombas uses the Rebuy app for cart upsells such as its wrapping upgrade offer.

bombas.stack.tag_manager.text: Bombas loads Google Tag Manager container GTM-5GRQ4C on its storefront.

bombas.stack.cookie_consent.text: Bombas uses OneTrust for cookie and privacy consent management.

bombas.stack.ab_testing.text: Bombas runs Optimizely for on site experimentation.

bombas.stack.performance_vendor.text: Bombas loads a Yottaa script, a web performance and edge acceleration vendor.

bombas.stack.form_security.value: hCaptcha, via Shopify storefront forms captcha
bombas.stack.form_security.text: Bombas protects storefront forms such as contact and login with hCaptcha through Shopify's storefront forms captcha module.

bombas.stack.agent_commerce_endpoint.value: UCP/MCP endpoint published for agent driven shopping, human approval required for payment
bombas.stack.agent_commerce_endpoint.text: Bombas publishes a UCP or MCP endpoint for AI shopping agents to read its catalog and cart, and its robots.txt states that payment requires explicit buyer approval.
